iti72:1.1: III.) Vuttaṃ hetaṃ bhagavatā vuttam-arahatā ti me sutaṃ.
iti72:2.1: Tisso imā bhikkhave nissaraṇiyā dhātuyo. Katamā tisso? Kāmānam-etaṃ nissaraṇaṃ yad-idaṃ nekkhammaṃ, rūpānam-etaṃ nissaraṇaṃ yadidaṃ āruppaṃ, yaṃ kho pana kiñci bhūtaṃ saṅkhataṃ paṭiccasamuppannaṃ nirodho tassa nissaraṇaṃ. Imā kho bhikkhave tisso nissaraṇiyā dhātuyo ti. Etam-atthaṃ bhagavā avoca, tatthetaṃ iti vuccati:
iti72:3.1: Kāmanissaraṇaṃ ñatvā rūpānañca atikkamaṃ | sabbasaṅkhārasamathaṃ phusaṃ ātāpī sabbadā ||
iti72:4.1: sa ve sammaddaso bhikkhu yato tattha vimuccati | abhiññāvosito santo sa ve yogātigo munī-ti ||
iti72:5.1: Ayam-pi attho vutto bhagavatā iti me sutan-ti ||3|| (Tik.
